standard_prerequisites.name: Base change of a representable transformation is representable
Properties of the relative-representable-property type are local on the base
standard_prerequisites.use: Descends property P from the covering to U.

core_obligations: Observe that a' is representable (proof lines 838-841).
Lift xi in G(U) to an fppf covering U_i -> U with sections of H (proof lines 842-845).
Write the comparison square and apply fppf locality of P (proof lines 845-857).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for functors F, G, H, a property P of the relative-representable-property type, a representable a : F -> G and an arbitrary b : H -> G whose induced map of fppf sheaves H^# -> G^# is surjective, if the base change a' of a along b has property P then so does a (source lines 818-836). The proof remarks that a' is representable, takes xi in G(U) and an fppf covering {U_i -> U} with xi_i in H(U_i) lifting xi, writes the comparison square whose left vertical arrow is the morphism of schemes with property P, and concludes by fppf locality of P.
